shape.text: The Atlas Administration API specification shows a service account secret, in full and in masked form, with an example value that begins mdb_sa_sk_ followed by an ellipsis.
The part of a service account secret after the mdb_sa_sk_ prefix has a documented alphabet and length.

unresolved.reason: No page read states them: the only shape shown is a truncated example, and a provider example does not prove a universal rule.

issuance.text: The full service account secret is returned only in the response that creates it; later reads return a masked value.

The client ID and secret are exchanged for an access token with an HTTP Basic Authorization header carrying the base64 of the two joined by a colon, posted to the Atlas token endpoint with the client credentials grant.

lifecycle.text: A service account secret has an expiration chosen when it is created, within bounds the organization controls, and is documented as rotatable.

collisions.text: The service account Client ID is a separate component documented as mdb_sa_id_ followed by 24 hexadecimal characters; it is the username-like half of the pair and not the secret.

openQuestions.text: Service account secrets were issued in an earlier form that differs from the mdb_sa_sk_ example.

unresolved.reason: No page read gives a history, and no archive snapshot was available to pin a historical claim.
